notes: Segment acceptance checklist templates (Phase 6, ADR 0014). A segment's required phases derive from the templates whose subject_kind='segment' and tag_type = the segment's segment_type (tag_type is reused as the subject-type discriminator, ADR 0014 §2). Pressure mains owe hydro -> disinfection -> bac-t; force mains owe hydro only (pressurized wastewater, not potable, so no disinfection/bac-t); gravity sewers owe air test -> mandrel/deflection -> manhole vacuum. Phases are camelCase here and snake_cased by the loader (bacT->bac_t, airTest->air_test). Every value governed by a project spec or referenced standard (AWWA C600 test pressure & allowable makeup water, C651 dose/residual/contact, ASTM air/mandrel/vacuum limits) is flagged confirm_per_spec:true — the template names the check; the project confirms the number. The bac-t template is the OPEN half of an open->resolve pair (ADR 0012): it is the sample-collection record, signed at collection with result 'pending'; the lab result returns later as a separate resolve check that points back via checks.resolves and carries the lab report as an attachment, never mutating this record. DOMAIN REVIEW NEEDED: item wording, which standards to cite, and the force_main test set are the maintainer's call.
